# Campaign Operations Manual

This handbook is written directly in Markdown by the campaign staff. It has
no PDF counterpart, and the reconciliation logic must treat it as its own
source of truth: it may only disappear from the index when this file itself
is deleted from the library.

## Session Zero Checklist

Gather the players and agree on tone, safety tools, and scheduling. Collect
character concepts and confirm that every player has a rules reference
available. Record the party roster in the shared campaign log so the
assistant can answer questions about who plays whom.

## House Rules

Critical hits roll double dice rather than doubling the total. Potions can
be consumed as a bonus action, but administering one to another character
still takes a full action. Encumbrance is tracked narratively unless a
player asks for the detailed rules.

## Downtime Activities

Between adventures each character may pick one downtime activity: crafting,
carousing, research, or training. Research grants one true rumor about the
next adventure location. Carousing builds a contact in the settlement where
the party rests.
